types.name: ResearchCommons.G4.AlgebraicProfile.finite_original_generators
types.printed_type:
@G4.AlgebraicProfile.finite_original_generators : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
  {ι : Type u_2} (f : ι → R), ∃ J, Ideal.span (Set.range f) = Ideal.span (f '' ↑J)

types.name: ResearchCommons.G4.AlgebraicProfile.finite_vanishing_equations
ResearchCommons.G4.AlgebraicProfile.finite_response_equations
types.printed_type:
@G4.AlgebraicProfile.finite_response_equations : ∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} {σ : Type u_3} {ι : Type u_4}
  [inst : CommRing K] [IsNoetherianRing K] [inst_2 : CommRing L] [Finite σ] (P : ι → MvPolynomial σ K) (a : ι → K)
  (coeff : K →+* L),
  ∃ J,
    ∀ (η : σ → L),
      (∀ (i : ι), (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom coeff η) (P i) = coeff (a i)) ↔
        ∀ i ∈ J, (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom coeff η) (P i) = coeff (a i)
